Aisha (CSM): Quick prep note 52 Preparing an Emerald quarterly check-in focused on enablement + renewal risks. Need a tight 6-slide deck and a 30m run-through. Can folks make a dry-run tomorrow 11:00am PT?

Miguel (Account Exec): I can do 11:00. Heads-up: execs will likely ask about the payment terms ask and the two stalled integrations.

Priya (SuccessOps): 11:00 works for me. Proposed slide outline: 1) One-line account summary + health score, 2) Usage trends & adoption, 3) Open onboarding blockers, 4) Risks & mitigation owners, 5) Pricing options/ask, 6) Next steps & timing.

Tom (Product): FYI I0m on a delivery call at that time. I69ll add a brief note on the connector work and ETA to slide 3 by EOD.

Aisha (CSM): Thanks Tom. Quick health metrics to include: health score 71/100, NPS recent 40, active seats 6/8, daily core flow adoption +14% WoW, 2 blocked connectors preventing go-live for two teams.

Jenna (Eng PM): Confirming ownership on integrations. Eng team has scope freeze; blockers are vendor webhook changes and sandbox access. ETA to unblock: 10 business days if vendor signs access. I69ll add a short timeline to the notes.

Miguel (Account Exec): I69ll draft 3 pricing options: status quo, 3-month bridge discount, and enterprise commit. Will post slide by 5pm PT. Customer signaled budget pressure during procurement call last week.

Priya (SuccessOps): I uploaded a starter deck: https://redwood.slides/emerald-qtr-checkin (v0.1). Left comments on slide 4 for risk owners.

Aisha (CSM): Miguel 52 when you post pricing options can you also add preferred exec ask timeline (e.g., 15-30 min exec alignment this month)? That helps on the ask slide.

Miguel (Account Exec): Yep. I69ll propose 20-min exec slot + a 5-minute procurement sync afterwards.

Priya (SuccessOps): Action list (capturing):
- Health + usage slide (Priya) 60 due today 4:30pm PT
- Integration status & ETA (Jenna/Tom) 60 due today EOD
- Pricing options slide (Miguel) 60 due today 5pm PT
- Exec ask one-pager (Aisha) 60 due tomorrow 9am PT
- Run-through scheduled (calendar-bot)

calendar-bot: Meeting scheduled 52 Emerald quarterly check-in dry-run, Tomorrow 11:00am PT, 30m. Invite sent to: Aisha, Miguel, Priya, Tom, Jenna. Recording enabled.

Aisha (CSM): Perfect. One more ask 52 please add a 1-line outcome we want from the exec meeting (e.g., procurement commitment or short-term bridge approval). Put that in the deck notes so execs see it pre-brief.

Tom (Product): I69ll add the technical note and blocker details to the slide notes.

Jenna (Eng PM): Added timeline and blocked items to slide notes.

Miguel (Account Exec): Pricing slide uploaded: https://redwood.slides/emerald-qtr-checkin#slide=5 (comments enabled).

Aisha (CSM): Thanks all. Closing loop 52 run-through tomorrow 11:00am PT. If anything changes ping here. :thumbsup:
